name: movie_etaori_lpqi_2orbits_node90
label: Movie: eta Ori Aa through two orbits, sixteen consecutive nights, line of nodes rotated by 90 deg (H-alpha, MPD)
notes: The movie_etaori_lpqi_orbit_node90 plan continued for a second orbit: sixteen consecutive nights. With P = 7.98763 d the nightly phase step is 0.1252, so night 9 falls at phase 1.0016 and the second orbit repeats the first's phases; a gap of whole nights cannot change that (0.0002 per day of gap, half a step after 323 days), and the offsets reachable within a season sample less informative phases, so consecutive nights are the best second orbit. The closing global fit shows how the fringe-alias islands of one orbit fare.
The eclipse nights, the third light and the per-night fit are as in the PA 0 campaign; compare the two movies' fringe amplitudes and the final sigma(a)/a.
